text:
laura: Heads-up 1: roadmap decision needed for a customer private-pilot. Scope: per-tenant reserved capacity, quick prewarm, and KMS-backed keying. Can we call out minimal launch criteria + blockers?
jin: From runtime POV: prewarm needs serialized KV + model weights priming. Prototype timeline ~2.5w. Need a clear perf target to validate.
rob: Infra: reserving capacity is possible but region-eu1 is tight. We can carve 8 soft-reserved slots now; more requires node add (~3w). Also need a simple eviction policy.
tana: Security: KMS integration + audit trail required. HSM optional for the pilot but we need key lifecycle & rotation docs. ETA for checklist: 5 business days.
laura: Minimal acceptance we propose: 1) cold->p95 under 500ms for prewarmed path, 2) reserved slot fallback to hosted routing under saturation, 3) key decrypt at boot via KMS and logs for each key use. Thoughts?
jin: p95 500ms seems reasonable as a start. For the prototype I'll aim for p95 < 400ms on short prompts (<=128 tokens). Will include perf harness.
rob: Fallback routing: infra can add route table rule to prefer private slots, then hosted pool. Need product to define SLA for fallback (e.g., allowed X% routed out).
tana: Also need explicit acceptance around retention of audit logs (90d?) and who owns the logs for private targets.
laura: Product prefers 90d retention to start. Owner: laura will own acceptance tests and customer comms.
jin: Owner: runtime prewarm proto 1 - jin. ETA: 18 business days.
rob: Owner: infra carve + fallback 1 - rob. ETA: carve 8 slots by Apr 14, node add if needed by May 5.
tana: Owner: security checklist & KMS path 1 - tana. ETA: Apr 12.
laura: OK. Can we do a short sync to confirm interfaces Tuesday 10am PT? Put the API shape and config example in the ticket before then.
jin: I'll post a simple config snippet for reserved slots and prewarm TTL tonight. Example:
```yaml
tenant_reserved:
  count: 8
  prewarm_ttl: 15m
  fallback: hosted_pool
```
rob: I'll add capacity numbers and a fallback flow diagram.
infra-bot: Meeting created: "Private pilot interface sync" Tue 10:00 PT. Invites to @laura @jin @rob @tana.
laura: Thanks 1. I'll update the roadmap item and tag the customer. Ping here if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
